title: Returnable Merchandise and Per-Order Return Limits — Returns & Exchanges
content:
This Returns & Exchanges list sets, per return type, which merchandise may be returned, whether defect photos are needed, whether part of a multi-unit line may come back, and how many return authorizations one order may carry.

| Return type | Defect photos required before authorization | Most open return authorizations per order | Final-sale lines returnable | Swimwear and intimates only with hygiene liner and tags intact | Gift-card lines returnable | Monogrammed or personalised items returnable | Part of a multi-unit line returnable |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Standard Return | No | 3 | No | Yes | No | No | Yes |
| Store Credit Return | No | 3 | No | Yes | No | No | Yes |
| Size Exchange | No | 3 | No | Yes | No | No | Yes |
| Instant Exchange | No | 3 | No | Yes | No | No | Yes |
| Gift Return | No | 3 | No | Yes | No | No | Yes |
| Quality Issue Return | Yes | 3 | Yes | No | No | Yes | Yes |

## Reading the list

- "Open return authorizations" counts the authorizations on the order that are not cancelled or expired.
- Gift-card lines are not returnable on any type.
- The Quality Issue Return differs from every other type on four settings: it needs defect photos, it accepts final-sale lines and personalised items, and it does not impose the hygiene-liner condition on swimwear and intimates.

Example (hypothetical): a final-sale dress is not returnable on a Standard Return; the same dress with a seam failure in normal use, returned as a Quality Issue Return with defect photos on file, is not barred by the final-sale setting.
